name: Noah Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To Esther Louisa Nesbitt (1839-1918), per FamilySearch

bioAdditions: FamilySearch dates Noah's marriage to Esther Louisa Nesbitt to 15 Nov 1857, places him in Plymouth in every census from 1850 to 1880, and attaches an Ohio death record (1908-1953) of a son, Frank E. Pringle, that names Noah as his father (S1). That son is not yet in the tree.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Noah Pringle (LWNW-PX9), with attached index entries
sources.supports: marriage date; son Frank E. in Ohio

researchLogEntry: Round 4: FamilySearch gives m. 15 Nov 1857 and a son Frank E. Pringle, d. in Ohio, whose death record names Noah.
